name: Poll
badge: shared web component + Discourse class layer
summary: A poll or vote block for a forum post or web page: radio or checkbox rows, a Vote button, results as progress bars with a percent and a vote count, a voter count line, a closed state and results shown after you vote. Ships as a web component and as a class layer (lib/discourse-poll.css) for the Discourse poll plugin's own markup.
highlights: Results bars with percent and count
Results after vote, and a closed state
Web component, or a Discourse class layer
lead: ONE custom element, <aha-poll>, built only from DS parts: options are <aha-radio> rows (selection-mode="single") or <aha-checkbox> rows ("multiple"), the submit is a primary <aha-button>, each result is an <aha-progressbar> under its label with the percent (SemiBold) and the vote count (tertiary), and the voter count sits in one 14px tertiary line. `results` sets when people may see the results: always, on-vote (after they vote) or on-close. `status="closed"` disables the rows, hides Vote and shows the results with a lock line. The element fires `vote` with the picked ids; the host saves it, then sets `voted`, `counts` and `voters`, and the bars animate in place. A host that renders its own poll (the Discourse poll plugin, which casts and loads votes itself) links lib/discourse-poll.css: the Discourse tab maps each plugin class to its DS value.
codeNote: Same element, same shadow-DOM CSS, identical render. React and Vue pass attributes (JSON for options, counts and value) and listen for `vote`. The Discourse class layer is hand-mapped to the same values and a test compares it to the element.

spec.label: Block
spec.value: 1px border-default #E3E3E3 · radius 8 · padding 16 · 16 between parts · bg-container

spec.label: Options
spec.value: <aha-radio> (single) or <aha-checkbox> (multiple) rows · min 24px high · 12 apart · label 14/21

spec.label: Vote
spec.value: primary <aha-button> "Vote", disabled until an option is picked; hidden once results show

spec.label: Result row
spec.value: label left (SemiBold with a system-check named Your vote on your own pick) · percent SemiBold text-default and "N votes" text-tertiary right · <aha-progressbar> under it (8px track gray-30 #F1F1F1, fill color-primary #E70E68), 4 below the label

spec.label: Percent
spec.value: single choice: of all votes; multiple choice: of voters, so the bars can add up to more than 100%

spec.label: Info line
spec.value: 14px / 1.5 · Regular · text-tertiary #616161 · "N voters" and the status

spec.label: Results after vote
spec.value: results="on-vote": rows and "Results show after you vote" until `voted`, then the bars; tertiary "Change vote" goes back to the rows

spec.label: Closed
spec.value: status="closed": results only, no buttons, system-lock + "Poll closed" in the info line

props.name: poll-title
props.desc: Optional question shown above the options; also the options group's accessible name

props.name: options
props.desc: The options in order. Labels are set as text, never parsed as HTML

props.name: voters
props.desc: People who voted; the base for multiple-choice percentages

props.name: value
props.desc: Picked option ids (the reader's vote once `voted`)

props.name: results
props.desc: When readers may see the results

props.name: status
props.desc: closed: results only, controls disabled, lock line

props.name: voted
props.desc: The reader has voted: the results show, with their pick marked

props.name: vote (event)
props.desc: Fired by Vote with the picked ids; save it, then set voted, counts and voters

whenToUse.when: a vote inside a page or forum post, where people see the tally after voting
the Discourse poll plugin renders the poll and casts the votes
an audience answering a question on a presented deck (the frosted deck surface)
a form choice that is not a vote and shows no tally

opinion.note: The element never saves a vote: listen for `vote`, store it, then set `voted`, `counts` and `voters`. Keep options in authored order; do not sort by votes. In Discourse use the class layer so the plugin keeps casting and loading votes.
opinion.dsv3: EXTENSION — DS V3 has no poll block. Composed from <aha-radio>, <aha-checkbox>, <aha-button> and <aha-progressbar> on --aha-* tokens, with the List row spacing.

snippets.label: HTML
snippets.note: The native form: a web component in an HTML file renders on open, no build step.

snippets.label: Discourse theme

selfCheck.label: rows are real <aha-radio> / <aha-checkbox>, submit a primary <aha-button>
results are <aha-progressbar> with percent (600) and count in text-tertiary
bars update in place, so the fill animates

conformance.$about: Measured by qa.mjs against the rendered element (getComputedStyle via headless CDP). The probe is a voted poll, so the results, info line and border all render; the measure also proves real <aha-progressbar> elements are nested.
